mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate signals monetary tightening, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals strong labor demand, driving corporate earnings growth and lifting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns not positive in >60% of triggered instances, or 5-day returns not statistically significant (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly growth in GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust demand across sectors, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST increase by >5% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive in >60% of triggered instances, or returns not statistically significant (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeding 105 signals supply-side expansion, lowering inflation expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not positive in >60% of triggered instances, or returns not statistically significant (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous 1% rise in federal funds rates and 0.5% drop in unemployment rate signals conflicting but supportive macro conditions, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by >1% AND UNRATE decreases by >0.5% in the same month
regime_hint: policy tightening with labor market strength
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive in >60% of triggered instances, or returns not statistically significant (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sharp decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% exerts stronger positive pressure on corporate earnings and equity valuations, driving significant S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive in >60% of instances during late-cycle regimes, or returns not statistically significant (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in housing starts below 1100 signals weakening demand, dampening equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not negative in >60% of triggered instances, or returns not statistically significant (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly growth in GDP (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) above 105 signals robust demand and supply-side expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO above 105 in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not positive in >60% of triggered instances, or returns not statistically significant (t-test p > 0.05).
